text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days after pledging a comeback with 
Lucky Lilac...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To find what we needed for the journey 
ahead, Lucky Lilac and I headed to the 
place where it all began—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had come to watch the Hanshin JF, the 
race where she was first crowned queen.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Coming around the fourth corner and 
turning into the homestretch! Second 
favorite Chrono Genesis is moving up as 
well!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ââHAAAAAAAAHH!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The two favorites are swooping in from the 
far outside!! What incredible momentum!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Across the line!! Out in front is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Winning Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I did it...!! I did it, I did itーーーー!! 
I'm the new queenーー!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
All right! It starts right here...!! My 
very own story!!!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I still have a long way to go... My 
Genesis Method is...—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
The race favorite wins three straight to 
become the Junior Class Queen, huh... 
She's so strong!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Chrono Genesis was so close too~. Next 
year's Classic races are gonna be so 
exciting~!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...The winner has such a lovely look on 
her face.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure... she's thinking something like, 
'I am the invincible queen!' right now.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. It was the same for me back then, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Has it really been a year already? It 
feels kinda weird.
choice_data_list:
...Now that you're actually here, how is 
it?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I can remember it like it was yesterday. 
Back at that time—

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"Congrats, Lucky Lilac! We're expecting 
big things from you moving forward!!"

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"You're so cool, new queen!! Good luck 
with the Triple Tiara too!!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...It was such a warm voice. Hearing it, 
what slowly welled up inside me was—"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Did ya see that?! I'm the queen! Be sure 
to cheer for me from now on~!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...It was the kind of feeling that makes 
you want to puff out your chest with 
pride.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Partly because I was training with 
Buena-san, who was on a whole other level, 
that's also what I was thinking back then.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"'I'll blast right past whoever comes my 
way.' 'I'm the invincible queen!'—"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...I didn't fear a single thin', back 
then.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
And yet, somewhere along the way... it 
wasn't like that anymore, was it—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...I want to take it back once more.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
The way I felt back then. That confidence 
of 'I'm invincible' and 'nothing can scare 
me.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The confidence she will soon regain. Here 
at her origin, I question the sense of 
self that lies at its root.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
She is an Umamusume who wants to become 
"Queen" once more.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, I'll become it once more. An 
invincible "Queen" who fears nothing and 
no one—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That night. When I returned to the 
academy—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Is that the sound of a harmonica?
choice_data_list: Where on earth did that come from...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Casually following the sound of the 
harmonica and Lucky Lilac, before I knew 
it, I had walked all the way out to the 
nighttime track.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. ...I thought they were someone you 
were well acquainted with, but—

――Curse him. Meddling where he wasn't 
needed.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: O-Orfe-san...!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was surprised by this encounter with 
Orfevre, as if guided by fate. However, 
depending on how you look at it, this was—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(...This might be a massive chance. For me 
to take a step forward...!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Um, Orfe-san! If you wouldn't mind—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I don't mind.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
You wish to show what you're truly made of 
right now before this "King," do you not?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: "I will allow it. ...However—"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Know that you are with your back to the 
wall.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
There will be no second chance. If you 
dampen My amusement this time—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I shall personally deliver your last 
rites.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(No mistake about it...! She's 
serious...!! This is Orfe-san's true, 
genuine power...!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(I can't stop shakin'. The way I am right 
now, I'm no match for—)

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Did you lose your nerve?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: —No.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Taking you up on your offer, allow me to 
demonstrate.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(That's right. That's precisely why I 
gotta go right now...!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(If I can't push through right here, I'll 
never become the "Queen"! I gotta show 
'em!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Just who I really am!!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Very well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, a mock race between Orfevre and 
Lucky Lilac suddenly began—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAAAAAH!!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Even after I shook her off, she overtook 
me in an instant! So this is Orfe-san's 
true power...!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (So blindingly bright——BUT STILL!!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (I'm gonna become the "Queen"!!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaahhhhhh!!!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(I ain't runnin' away, no matter what! 
I'll call out anyone, anywhere! That's the 
"Queen" I'm aimin' to be!!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (————This is my way of life!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... haa... Th-Thank... you very 
much...—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...It is not enough.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Power. Technique. Spirit. I lack all of 
it.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Yet, she showed no fear of me.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: That's a fine way to live.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Do your utmost and press forward.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...!! Th-Thank you very much...!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...I managed to show it, somehow—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
It feels like I can start again from here. 
Once more, on the path to becoming 
"Queen."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a refreshed mindset and a refined way 
of life.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The flowers will begin to bloom once 
again—
